observations: Photo 0: Two orange gas cylinders visible; one foreground with a valve/regulator fitting on top; another behind it.
Photo 1: Similar view of the cylinders; foreground cylinder valve/regulator fitting visible; cylinders show surface wear/scuffs.
Photo 2: Close-up of the top/front of an orange cylinder; a stamped/printed marking area is visible but not clearly readable; cylinder has a handle and typical LPG cylinder shape.

claims.evidence: The photos show LPG cylinders, but the exact capacity (12.5kg) is not clearly readable from the markings in the provided images.
No test results, inspection tags, or leak/pressure proof is shown in the photos.
Condition appears worn (scuffs/rust-like marks), but overall quality/durability cannot be confirmed remotely.

risks.risk: Capacity may not be 12.5kg (could be another size), which changes value and refill compatibility.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the cylinder’s stamped capacity/serial markings (including the kg rating) and/or the cylinder neck ring text.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not-confirmed capacity (worst case: treat as a lower-value used cylinder size).

risks.risk: Leak/valve condition not verifiable from photos (could be faulty valve/regulator or leaking seal).
risks.proof: Video of a soapy-water leak test at the valve/regulator connection and the cylinder body seam (no bubbles).
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially needing service/repair (worst case: treat as not guaranteed leak-free).

risks.risk: Cylinder certification/inspection status unknown (may be expired or not fit for exchange/refill).
risks.proof: Photo of the inspection/expiry stamp or compliance tag on the cylinder (clear date/markings).
risks.if_unproven: Price as exchange/refill not guaranteed (worst case: treat as limited usability).

risks.risk: Quantity/which exact cylinders are included is unclear (photos show multiple cylinders but not a confirmed count).
risks.proof: A single wide shot showing all cylinders included in the deal, counted clearly.
risks.if_unproven: Price per cylinder as shown, but assume the deal may include fewer than expected until count is confirmed.

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the cylinder markings showing the exact capacity (kg) and serial/ID.
Photo of the inspection/expiry stamp or compliance tag with readable date.
Video showing soapy-water leak test at the valve/regulator connection and cylinder seams.
A wide shot confirming the exact number of cylinders included in the pickup.
response.reason: The item type is identifiable as LPG cylinders, but the key pricing drivers (exact 12.5kg capacity, inspection/expiry status, and leak/valve condition) are not readable or testable from the photos. To avoid a confident wrong price, request the decisive proof first.
